text: The CRCF is unique in its focus on enhancing capability rather than funding capital works. It provides funding for technical investigations, project management, and risk categorization to accelerate recovery processes. The fund supports managed retreat and voluntary buyouts in high-risk areas, particularly in Auckland and Gisborne. It aligns with broader climate resilience and recovery initiatives, complementing over $1 billion in cyclone-related funding.

metadata.solution_name: Cyclone Recovery Capability Fund (CRCF) — councils’ capability support for recovery functions, including voluntary buyouts, under Budget 2024
